thread:
marie: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout for feature 'embed-cache-ttl' today during the 15:30 PT deploy window. Need a deploy owner, rollback plan, and smoke checklist.
ash: I can own the deploy. 15:30 PT works. I'll be available for the full 1hr window.
leo: I'll take metrics/watch. Will open a dashboard for latency/errors and set alerts for >2% error or +30ms p50.
namita: Suggest rollout slices: 2% for 8m, 10% for 12m, 40% for 20m, then 100% if green. Keep region slicing: start in us-west, then us-east, then eu-west.
marie: Good call on regions. Can we gate by both region and percent? I want rollback fast if we hit an anomaly.
ash: Yes — pipeline supports slice routing. I'll configure rollout manifest like: 
```
rollout:
  steps:
    - percent: 2
      duration: 8m
      regions: [us-west]
    - percent: 10
      duration: 12m
      regions: [us-west, us-east]
    - percent: 40
      duration: 20m
      regions: [all]
    - percent: 100
      duration: 0m
```
namita: For smoke checks, run the quick-suite: `smoke/priority-endpoints`, `smoke/kv-read`, and `smoke/embed-hits`. If any fail, abort rollout.
leo: I'll set alerts on these queries + throttling metrics. Also will monitor token throughput and tail latency.
marie: Rollback plan: ash, can you confirm how to trigger immediate rollback (manual and automated)? Document the exact commands in the thread.
ash: Manual rollback = `deploy rollback --release previous --force`. Automated: if `alerts.triggered > 0` for the smoke-suite within step window, pipeline will pause and notify `#eng-oncall` and release owner. I'll add notify hooks.
devops-bot: Pipeline planned: embed-cache-ttl/2026-03-17T15:30Z scheduled by ash. Canary config attached.
namita: One more: please don't exceed concurrent batch size > 128 during canary, we saw memory spikes last time. ash, can you set max-batch to 64 for canary slices?
ash: Done — will set max_batch=64 for first two steps.
leo: I'll be watching. If latencies creep >30ms p50 or error >1.5% we abort.
marie: Perfect. Owners: ash (deploy), leo (metrics/watch), namita (smoke/asserts). Slack pings only for critical alerts; otherwise we'll post a short postmortem in #eng-releases if anything unusual. :thumbsup:
ash: Ready. I'll kick at 15:30 PT and post status in this thread after each step.
leo: I'll post a final green when at 100% or the time we abort.
namita: Copy — I'll run smoke checks after each percent step and post results (pass/fail + quick logs).
marie: Thanks everyone — see you at 15:30.
